why: the engineer at a laptop late at night presses deploy; beside them the store's order counter slows and flatlines
the meeting room drawn from above; one by one every head swivels until all of them point at the engineer, then the frame holds on that moment
the presenter, beside a small sketch of the room, promises three steps; the words toward the system settle under them
the frozen room from the hook, with the word accountability hovering over the engineer and a question mark beside it
the engineer's thought bubble holds two sketches, the deploy screen and the first thing they tried; as the heads stay turned the bubble shrinks and fades, unsaid
a short left to right chain of three linked boxes, each arriving as it is said
the term large at the top; beneath it three targets light in turn, the system, the conditions, the decisions, while a small figure of a person stays unmarked
a split card: on one side the two things that stay, full account and owns the fixes, drawn firmly and ticked
the other half of the split card: punishment for an honest mistake is struck through; a small side note for reckless acts points out of the room
the faded thought bubble returns small in the corner; the team lead writes the ground rule as a header across the whiteboard, where it stays for the rest of the meeting
a timeline draws itself left to right under the header, with empty moment markers spaced along the night
the timeline fills: at each moment a small screen shows only what that person could see then, review passed, staging green, a phone with no alert
the hindsight answer hovers in grey above the timeline; it drops toward each small screen in turn and is on none of them; the term hindsight bias is written beside it
two short step cards side by side, the first two of three slots filled
the manager's why question appears in a speech bubble; the engineer's small thought bubble begins to shrink again while the lead turns toward the manager
the why question is crossed out and the what question is written beside it; under each, what it gets you, a name or something to fix
a second who question appears in a speech bubble with an empty space beside it for the viewer's rewrite
the who question is crossed out and the how question written beside it; then the through-line question is written large across the board, and everything slows
a single arrow runs from the failed checkout straight to the engineer, labelled human error; then it is erased
three arrows grow in from different parts of the system, each as it is named, and converge on the failed checkout; the words several conditions settle under them
the question and three finding cards as peers, then a real silent pause
card B is marked with its only fix, be more careful; then cards A and C glow as system conditions while B stays grey
the action-item card reads be more careful, with the three conditions from the arrows still standing beside it; then it is struck through
three system changes replace the struck-through card, one per condition, each arriving as it is said
each of the three fixes gains an owner tag, then its checkbox ticks to done, one after another
a blank three-step card for the viewer's own incident, its slots empty during a short quiet gap
the three slots fill one at a time, then one fix line with an owner tag appears at the bottom of the card
the meeting room from the hook, drawn from above; every head swivels from the engineer to the board, where the three converging conditions each carry an owned, ticked fix
the presenter closes, level and firm, beside the pocket rule
